# Ceiling for the number of client_golang metric families declared in non-test code
# under internal/, pkg/ and cmd/. See ratchet_test.go (TestClientGolangConstructorRatchet).
#
# What is counted: calls to prometheus.New{Counter,Gauge,Histogram,Summary,Untyped}[Vec|Func]
# and the same names on promauto, calls to newPebbleDesc with a string-literal first
# argument, and prometheus.NewDesc calls outside the body of newPebbleDesc. The registry
# bridge's bridgeDesc (internal/telemetry/telemetry.go only, until R1-15) is treated the
# same way: its body is skipped and a call with a string-literal name counts.
#
# This number may only be LOWERED, by hand, in the PR that moves a family to OTel.
# Never raise it to make a PR pass. Print the current count with:
#   go test -count=1 -v -run TestClientGolangConstructorRatchet ./internal/telemetrypolicy/
63
